Terms of Use

A guide to using Yokkai responsibly: your account, your collection, and your interactions with other collectors.

Publisher: Yokkai Collec

Effective date: October 20, 2026.

01
About Yokkai and these terms

Yokkai Collec' is an unofficial fan project for collecting virtual cards, opening packs, completing binders, customizing cards, and connecting with other collectors. These terms describe the rules for using the website and its features. The community rules also apply. You can read more about the game on the Info page.

02
Accounts and younger collectors

Yokkai is not an adults-only service. Minors may use the service when the legal requirements that apply to them are met. If local law requires permission from a parent or legal guardian to create an account, enter into an agreement, make a purchase, or consent to particular uses of personal data, that permission must be obtained before the relevant activity. A parent's permission does not override any minimum age imposed by applicable law.

Use an email address you control, complete email verification when requested, and keep your sign-in details private. Do not impersonate another person, share account access, or sell accounts. Contact us if you believe someone has accessed your account without permission.

03
Fair play and community safety
Do not harass, threaten, discriminate against, scam, or impersonate other people. Do not post illegal, sexually explicit, or abusive content, including in profiles, custom images, GIFs, or messages.
Do not use bots, exploit bugs, bypass access controls, manipulate trades or auctions, or create accounts to farm referrals and rewards.
Keep private information private. Do not share someone else's personal information without a lawful basis. Report safety issues or suspected abuse using the available report tools or our contact email.

Packs, cards, Karas, and exchanges

Regular Packs contain random virtual cards. Decision Packs let you choose from the cards revealed. A pack does not guarantee a particular character or rarity unless an explicit offer says otherwise. Current pack information and rarity information are available in the game and on the Rarities page.

Cards, packs, and Karas are in-game items, not money or an investment. They have no cash-redemption value and do not grant ownership of the characters or artwork they depict. Do not sell them for real money outside the service. Review the cards and Kara amounts carefully before placing a bid or accepting a trade. Exchanges are subject to the game's ownership, balance, and eligibility checks.

05
Your content and intellectual property

Characters, franchises, artwork, names, and trademarks belong to their respective rights holders. Yokkai is not affiliated with or endorsed by them. Being displayed in the game does not mean that an image is free for other uses.

You must have the necessary rights or other lawful authorization for images, GIFs, messages, and other content you submit. You keep any rights you hold in your own content. You give Yokkai only the permission needed to host, process, and display that content to operate the features you use, including sharing it with the people or audiences you select. This does not transfer ownership of your content to Yokkai. Content may be removed when it violates rights or the community rules. Contact us to report a rights concern.

06
Optional paid features

Some features, such as Pro subscriptions, may require payment. Review the price, included benefits, billing period, renewal information, and cancellation conditions displayed before checkout. Where offered, web payments are handled through Stripe. Minors must have any authorization required by law before making a purchase.

Use the subscription controls provided in your account to manage or cancel a subscription, or contact us for help. Cancellation, withdrawal, and refund requests are handled under the terms shown at purchase and applicable law. Mandatory consumer rights remain unaffected. These terms do not, by themselves, waive a statutory withdrawal right for digital content or services; any legally required express consent and acknowledgment must be obtained separately.

07
Personal data and account controls

Use account settings to manage the available privacy controls, request an export of your account data, or delete your account. Think carefully before posting information in a public profile or sharing it with another collector. These terms are not a substitute for the privacy information or specific consent requests required for personal-data processing. Read the Privacy Policy to learn how your data is used. Questions about your data or privacy rights can be sent to our contact email.

08
Moderation and closing an account

To protect collectors and the service, we may remove content, restrict features, or suspend accounts in response to rule violations, fraud, or security risks. Measures should be proportionate to the circumstances and comply with applicable law. Contact us if you believe a moderation decision was mistaken or want it reviewed.

You may stop using Yokkai at any time and use account settings to request deletion. Review any active subscriptions, bids, and trades first. Information may need to be retained where the law requires it. Account closure does not remove any rights or obligations that legally survive closure, including any applicable refund rights.

09
Availability, changes, and your rights

Features may change, and maintenance or technical problems can interrupt access. We cannot promise uninterrupted availability or an error-free service. This does not exclude any legal guarantees or liability that cannot lawfully be limited.

If these terms change, an updated version and its effective date will be made available. Material changes will be communicated, and fresh agreement obtained, where required by law. Nothing here removes mandatory consumer protections, data-protection rights, or your right to seek help from a competent authority or court.

10
Contact

For account help, safety reports, rights concerns, or questions about these terms, email yokkaicollec@gmail.com. Never send your password or full payment details by email.

YOUR DATA

Privacy Policy

What we collect when you play Yokkai, why we need it, who can see it, and how you stay in control.

Last updated: October 26, 2026.

01
Who we are and how to contact us

Yokkai Collec' is the data controller for the personal data processed through this website. For any question or request about your data, email yokkaicollec@gmail.com. Never send your password or sign-in codes by email.

02
What data we collect
Account: your email address, password, and username. Your password is handled by our authentication system and stored only in hashed form. We also record the version and time of the policies you accepted at sign-up, and the referral code you used, if any. Confirmation and password-reset emails are sent through our email provider.
Security checks: sign-in, sign-up, and password forms use a Cloudflare Turnstile challenge to block bots. Your IP address may be used to protect sign-in against abuse.
Profile: avatar, banner, background and card-back images you upload, bio, interests, showcase cards, profile layout and Pro styling, your profile privacy setting, and when you were last active.
Game data: cards and collection, custom card images (links you provide), folders and binders, Karas balance, packs and pack timers, achievements and stats, wishlist, favorites, and notifications.
Social activity: friends and friend requests, trades, auctions and bids, auction chat messages and mentions, private messages, profile wall posts, replies, likes and reactions, GIFs you share, blocks, reports you send or receive, and referrals.
Sharing: the card share links you create, including whether you chose to show your username.
Subscription: your Stripe customer ID, checkout session ID, subscription status, current period end date, and whether cancellation is scheduled. See Payments below.
Technical data: server and database logs needed to run and secure the service.
03
Why we use it and legal basis
To provide the game and your subscription (performance of our contract with you): your account, collection, social features, and Pro benefits.
To meet billing and accounting requirements (legal obligation): records related to payments.
To keep Yokkai safe and fair (legitimate interest): security, bot protection, anti-cheat checks, rate limits, reports, and moderation.

We do not sell your personal data or use it for advertising.

04
What other players can see
Signed-in players can see your username, avatar, banner, bio, showcase, profile wall, and your activity in trades, auctions, and auction chat.
Your collection is visible to signed-in players when your profile is public. Set your profile to private in Settings to limit it to your friends.
Your friends can see whether you are online and when you were last active. Private messages are visible only to you and the recipient.
Visitors who are not signed in can only see the card share links you create: the card, its artwork, and your username only if you chose to show it. Uploaded avatar and banner images are served from public links.
Yokkai administrators can access account data, including your email address, to support players, moderate content, and secure the service.
05
Payments

Pro subscriptions are processed by Stripe through its hosted Checkout and Customer Portal pages. You enter your payment details directly on Stripe. We never see or store your card number or other payment card details.

We send Stripe only your Yokkai account ID and the selected plan. Stripe sends us back the subscription status and dates. Stripe processes your payment details and billing information under its own Privacy Policy.

06
Third-party services and international transfers
Hosting: the website, database, and uploaded images are hosted on a server in France (OVHcloud, managed with Coolify). Authentication emails are sent through OVHcloud.
Cloudflare: domain, network protection, and Turnstile bot checks.
Stripe: payments and subscriptions.
GIPHY: when you open the GIF picker, your browser sends your search terms to GIPHY. Shared GIFs are loaded from GIPHY by everyone who views them.
Image hosts: custom card images are loaded from the hosts their links point to, such as imgur.
Discord: the Discord link only opens our community server. We do not share your data with Discord.

When your browser loads content from these services, they receive your IP address and browser information. Stripe, Cloudflare, and GIPHY are among the services based in the United States, so your data may be transferred outside your country. These providers rely on legal safeguards for such transfers, such as standard contractual clauses or certification frameworks.

07
Cookies and local storage

We use one cookie, to keep you signed in. We do not use advertising cookies, and our website does not include analytics or tracking tools. Stripe sets its own cookies only on its own payment pages. Cloudflare may use cookies or similar technologies to run security checks. Your browser also stores these preferences on your device:

Sign-in cookie (sb-…-auth-token): Keeps you signed in. Required.
yokkai:collection-sort: Remembers how you sort your collection.
yokkai:filters-open:v1: Remembers which filter panels are open.
yokkai-sound-enabled: Remembers whether game sounds are on.
yokkai:pro-promotion:v1:dismissed-at: Remembers when you closed the Pro promotion.
yokkai-discord-promo-dismissed:<account ID>: Remembers that you closed the Discord reminder.
yokkai-referral-reminder-dismissed:<account ID>: Remembers that you closed the referral reminder.
yokkai:social-unread-invalidation: A random value that keeps unread counters in sync across your tabs.
08
How long we keep data
Account and game data: until you delete your account.
Database backups: up to 14 days, after which older backups are removed automatically.
Server logs and scheduled job history: about 7 days.
Authentication logs: kept only as long as needed for security.
Billing records: kept as long as required by accounting and tax law.
Deletion log (account ID and date only): kept so that a deletion can be applied again if a backup is restored.
09
Account deletion

You can delete your account at any time from Settings. Deletion is immediate and cannot be undone. Before deleting, you can download a copy of your data from Settings.

Deleted: your sign-in identity, profile, uploaded images, cards, folders, wishlist, achievements, notifications, auction chat messages, private messages, profile wall posts, friendships, blocks, and share links. Your active auctions and pending trades are canceled, and bids are refunded.
Subscription: an active Pro subscription is canceled immediately, without a new invoice. Stripe keeps the payment records it must retain for its own legal and accounting obligations.
Anonymized: past auctions, bids, trades, and reports stay in other players' history without any link to you and show “Deleted player”.
Kept: a log containing only your account ID and the deletion date, used to apply your deletion again if a backup is ever restored. Your data may remain in backups until they are removed.
10
Your rights

You have the right to access, correct, delete, and receive a portable copy of your data, to object to its processing, and to ask us to restrict it. Many of these controls are in Settings. For any other request, email yokkaicollec@gmail.com from your account email address.

You can also file a complaint with the data protection authority in your country of residence, such as the CNIL in France or the CNDP in Morocco.

11
Children

Yokkai is not intended for children under 16. You must be at least 16 years old to create an account. If an account belongs to a child under 16, it will be deleted on request sent to yokkaicollec@gmail.com.

12
Security

We use encrypted connections, hashed passwords, bot checks, rate limits, and access rules that limit each player to their own private data. No system is perfectly secure: keep your password private and contact us if you think your account has been accessed without permission.

13
Changes to this policy

We may update this policy when Yokkai changes. The date at the top of this page shows the latest version, and material changes will be announced in the game. Read our Terms of Use and community rules too.

COLLECTOR GUIDE

Card rarities

Every card belongs to one of five rarity tiers. The rarer the tier, the harder it is to pull and the more distinctive its presentation becomes.

01
The five tiers
C
Common
69.4%
R
Rare
20%
SR
Super Rare
10%
SSR
Super Super Rare
0.5%
LR
Legendary Rare
0.1%
LR SHINY
Legendary Rare · Shiny
0.001%

The first five percentages are the current Regular Pack odds for each individual card draw. An LR then has an independent 1% chance to be Shiny, making LR SHINY about a 1 in 100,000 pull per card.

Account: your email address, password, and username. Your password is handled by our authentication system and stored only in hashed form. Profile: avatar, banner, background and card-back images you upload, bio, interests, showcase cards, profile layout and Pro styling, your profile privacy setting, and when you were last active.
Game data: cards and collection, custom card images (links you provide), folders and binders, Karas balance, packs and pack timers, achievements and stats, wishlist, favorites, and notifications.
Social activity: friends and friend requests, trades, auctions and bids, auction chat messages and mentions, private messages, profile wall posts, replies, likes and reactions, GIFs you share, blocks, reports you send or receive, and referrals.
Sharing: the card share links you create, including whether you chose to show your username.
Subscription: your Stripe customer ID, checkout session ID, subscription status, current period end date, and whether cancellation is scheduled. See Payments below.
Technical data: server and database logs needed to run and secure the service.

To provide the game and your subscription (performance of our contract with you): your account, collection, social features, and Pro benefits.
To meet billing and accounting requirements (legal obligation): records related to payments.
To keep Yokkai safe and fair (legitimate interest): security, bot protection, anti-cheat checks, rate limits, reports, and moderation.

Your friends can see whether you are online and when you were last active. Private messages are visible only to you and the recipient.

Pro subscriptions are processed by Stripe through its hosted Checkout and Customer Portal pages. You enter your payment details directly on Stripe. We never see or store your card number or other payment card details.

Every card belongs to one of five rarity tiers. The rarer the tier, the harder it is to pull and the more distinctive its presentation becomes.

The first five percentages are the current Regular Pack odds for each individual card draw. An LR then has an independent 1% chance to be Shiny, making LR SHINY about a 1 in 100,000 pull per card.

02
Decision Packs

Decision Packs only contain high-rarity choices: SR at 96.5%, SSR at 3%, and LR at 0.5%. You reveal five cards and choose the one you want to keep. Each LR has the same 1% Shiny chance, so LR SHINY has a 0.005% chance per revealed card (1 in 20,000).

03
Shiny and evolved cards

Directly pulled Shiny cards are LR cards with an exclusive animated treatment. Fuse five identical standard SSR cards to create one SSR INFINITY, or three identical normal LR cards to create one LR INFINITY. LR Shiny and already evolved cards cannot be used for evolution. Shiny and evolved cards are special versions, not separate rarity tiers, and their collection status appears directly on the card.

04
Live odds

Pack odds may be rebalanced as the collection grows. The information panel beside each pack always shows the live rates used by the server.

01
Qui nous sommes et comment nous contacter

02
Les données que nous collectons
Compte : ton adresse e-mail, ton mot de passe et ton pseudo. Ton mot de passe est géré par notre système d’authentification et n’est stocké que sous forme hachée. Nous enregistrons aussi la version et la date des politiques que tu as acceptées à l’inscription, ainsi que le code de parrainage utilisé, le cas échéant. Les e-mails de confirmation et de réinitialisation du mot de passe sont envoyés par notre prestataire de messagerie.
Contrôles de sécurité : les formulaires de connexion, d’inscription et de mot de passe utilisent un défi Cloudflare Turnstile pour bloquer les bots. Ton adresse IP peut être utilisée pour protéger la connexion contre les abus.
Profil : les images d’avatar, de bannière, de fond et de dos de carte que tu téléverses, ta bio, tes centres d’intérêt, les cartes de ta vitrine, la disposition de ton profil et les styles Pro, ton réglage de confidentialité et la date de ta dernière activité.
Données de jeu : cartes et collection, images de cartes personnalisées (liens que tu fournis), dossiers et classeurs, solde de Karas, packs et leurs comptes à rebours, succès et statistiques, liste de souhaits, favoris et notifications.
Activité sociale : amis et demandes d’ami, échanges, enchères et mises, messages et mentions dans le chat des enchères, messages privés, posts sur les murs de profil, réponses, mentions J’aime et réactions, GIFs partagés, blocages, signalements envoyés ou reçus et parrainages.
Partage : les liens de partage de cartes que tu crées, y compris ton choix d’afficher ou non ton pseudo.
Abonnement : ton identifiant client Stripe, l’identifiant de session de paiement, l’état de l’abonnement, la date de fin de la période en cours et la programmation éventuelle de son annulation. Consulte la section Paiements ci-dessous.
Données techniques : journaux du serveur et de la base de données nécessaires au fonctionnement et à la sécurité du service.
03
Pourquoi nous les utilisons et sur quelle base légale
Pour fournir le jeu et ton abonnement (exécution de notre contrat avec toi) : ton compte, ta collection, les fonctionnalités sociales et les avantages Pro.
Pour respecter les exigences de facturation et de comptabilité (obligation légale) : documents relatifs aux paiements.
Pour préserver la sécurité et l’équité de Yokkai (intérêt légitime) : sécurité, protection contre les bots, contrôles contre la triche, limitations de fréquence, signalements et modération.

Nous ne vendons pas tes données personnelles et ne les utilisons pas à des fins publicitaires.

04
Ce que les autres joueurs peuvent voir
Les joueurs connectés peuvent voir ton pseudo, ton avatar, ta bannière, ta bio, ta vitrine, ton mur de profil et ton activité dans les échanges, les enchères et leur chat.
Ta collection est visible par les joueurs connectés lorsque ton profil est public. Rends ton profil privé dans les paramètres pour limiter sa visibilité à tes amis.
Tes amis peuvent voir si tu es en ligne et la date de ta dernière activité. Les messages privés ne sont visibles que par toi et leur destinataire.
Les visiteurs non connectés peuvent uniquement consulter les liens de partage de cartes que tu crées : la carte, son illustration et ton pseudo, seulement si tu as choisi de l’afficher. Les images d’avatar et de bannière téléversées sont accessibles par des liens publics.
Les administrateurs de Yokkai peuvent accéder aux données du compte, y compris à ton adresse e-mail, pour aider les joueurs, modérer les contenus et sécuriser le service.
05
Paiements

Les abonnements Pro sont traités par Stripe via ses pages hébergées Checkout et Customer Portal. Tu saisis tes informations de paiement directement sur Stripe. Nous ne voyons et ne stockons jamais ton numéro de carte ni les autres informations de ta carte de paiement.

Nous transmettons à Stripe uniquement ton identifiant de compte Yokkai et l’offre choisie. Stripe nous renvoie l’état et les dates de l’abonnement. Stripe traite tes informations de paiement et de facturation selon sa propre politique de confidentialité.

06
Services tiers et transferts internationaux
Hébergement : le site, la base de données et les images téléversées sont hébergés sur un serveur en France (OVHcloud, géré avec Coolify). Les e-mails d’authentification sont envoyés par OVHcloud.
Cloudflare : domaine, protection du réseau et contrôles anti-bots Turnstile.
Stripe : paiements et abonnements.
GIPHY : quand tu ouvres le sélecteur de GIFs, ton navigateur transmet tes termes de recherche à GIPHY. Les GIFs partagés sont chargés depuis GIPHY par toutes les personnes qui les consultent.
Hébergeurs d’images : les images de cartes personnalisées sont chargées depuis les hébergeurs vers lesquels pointent leurs liens, comme imgur.
Discord : le lien Discord ouvre uniquement notre serveur communautaire. Nous ne partageons pas tes données avec Discord.

Quand ton navigateur charge du contenu depuis ces services, ils reçoivent ton adresse IP et des informations sur ton navigateur. Stripe, Cloudflare et GIPHY font partie des services basés aux États-Unis ; tes données peuvent donc être transférées en dehors de ton pays. Ces prestataires s’appuient sur des garanties juridiques pour ces transferts, comme des clauses contractuelles types ou des cadres de certification.

07
Cookies et stockage local

Nous utilisons un cookie pour te garder connecté. Nous n’utilisons pas de cookies publicitaires et notre site ne comporte pas d’outils d’analyse ou de suivi. Stripe ne dépose ses propres cookies que sur ses pages de paiement. Cloudflare peut utiliser des cookies ou des technologies similaires pour effectuer des contrôles de sécurité. Ton navigateur stocke aussi ces préférences sur ton appareil :

Cookie de connexion (sb-…-auth-token): Te garde connecté. Nécessaire.
yokkai:collection-sort: Mémorise le tri de ta collection.
yokkai:filters-open:v1: Mémorise les panneaux de filtres ouverts.
yokkai-sound-enabled: Mémorise si les sons du jeu sont activés.
yokkai:pro-promotion:v1:dismissed-at: Mémorise quand tu as fermé la promotion Pro.
yokkai-discord-promo-dismissed:<account ID>: Mémorise que tu as fermé le rappel Discord.
yokkai-referral-reminder-dismissed:<account ID>: Mémorise que tu as fermé le rappel de parrainage.
yokkai:social-unread-invalidation: Une valeur aléatoire qui synchronise les compteurs de non-lus entre tes onglets.
08
Durée de conservation des données
Données du compte et du jeu : jusqu’à la suppression de ton compte.
Sauvegardes de la base de données : jusqu’à 14 jours, après quoi les sauvegardes les plus anciennes sont automatiquement supprimées.
Journaux du serveur et historique des tâches planifiées : environ 7 jours.
Journaux d’authentification : conservés uniquement le temps nécessaire à la sécurité.
Documents de facturation : conservés pendant la durée exigée par la législation comptable et fiscale.
Journal des suppressions (identifiant du compte et date uniquement) : conservé pour réappliquer une suppression si une sauvegarde est restaurée.
09
Suppression du compte

Tu peux supprimer ton compte à tout moment depuis les paramètres. La suppression est immédiate et irréversible. Avant de supprimer ton compte, tu peux télécharger une copie de tes données depuis les paramètres.

Supprimés : ton identité de connexion, ton profil, les images téléversées, les cartes, les dossiers, la liste de souhaits, les succès, les notifications, les messages du chat des enchères, les messages privés, les posts des murs de profil, les amitiés, les blocages et les liens de partage. Tes enchères actives et tes échanges en attente sont annulés, et les mises sont remboursées.
Abonnement : un abonnement Pro actif est annulé immédiatement, sans nouvelle facture. Stripe conserve les documents de paiement qu’il doit garder pour ses propres obligations légales et comptables.
Anonymisés : les enchères, mises, échanges et signalements passés restent dans l’historique des autres joueurs sans aucun lien avec toi et affichent « Joueur supprimé ».
Conservés : un journal contenant uniquement ton identifiant de compte et la date de suppression, utilisé pour réappliquer ta suppression si une sauvegarde est restaurée. Tes données peuvent rester dans les sauvegardes jusqu’à leur suppression.
10

Tu as le droit d’accéder à tes données, de les rectifier, de les supprimer et d’en recevoir une copie portable, de t’opposer à leur traitement et de nous demander de le limiter. Beaucoup de ces commandes sont disponibles dans les paramètres. Pour toute autre demande, écris à yokkaicollec@gmail.com depuis l’adresse e-mail de ton compte.

Tu peux aussi déposer une réclamation auprès de l’autorité de protection des données de ton pays de résidence, comme la CNIL en France ou la CNDP au Maroc.

Yokkai n’est pas destiné aux enfants de moins de 16 ans. Tu dois avoir au moins 16 ans pour créer un compte. Si un compte appartient à un enfant de moins de 16 ans, il sera supprimé sur demande envoyée à yokkaicollec@gmail.com.

Sécurité

Nous utilisons des connexions chiffrées, des mots de passe hachés, des contrôles anti-bots, des limitations de fréquence et des règles d’accès qui limitent chaque joueur à ses propres données privées. Aucun système n’est parfaitement sécurisé : garde ton mot de passe confidentiel et contacte-nous si tu penses qu’une personne a accédé à ton compte sans autorisation.

02
Decision Packs

Les Decision Packs proposent uniquement des choix de rareté élevée : SR à 96,5 %, SSR à 3 % et LR à 0,5 %. Tu révèles cinq cartes et choisis celle que tu souhaites garder. 03
Cartes Shiny et évoluées

Les cartes Shiny obtenues directement par tirage sont des LR dotées d’un traitement animé exclusif. Fusionne cinq cartes SSR normales identiques pour créer une SSR INFINITY, ou trois cartes LR normales identiques pour créer une LR INFINITY. Les LR Shiny et les cartes déjà évoluées ne peuvent pas servir à une évolution. Les cartes Shiny et évoluées sont des versions spéciales, et non des niveaux de rareté distincts ; leur état de collection apparaît directement sur la carte.

04
Probabilités actuelles

Les probabilités des packs peuvent être rééquilibrées à mesure que la collection s’agrandit. Le panneau d’information à côté de chaque pack affiche toujours les taux actuels utilisés par le serveur.
